_description: Landing-page SEO RECOMMENDATIONS for the two library index pages. Deliberately kept OUT of the 466-record detail metadata dataset (ab-test-seo-metadata.json / journey-seo-metadata.json) — these are index pages with a different intent profile, and mixing them into the detail corpus would corrupt every duplicate/cannibalization measurement. These are recommendations, not applied changes: nothing in src/lib/content.ts has been modified.

currentState.note: Route exists (src/app/(en)/lab/journeys/page.tsx + /tr counterpart). Detail pages at /lab/journeys/[slug] are live and prerendered via ALL_DETAIL_SLUGS.

recommendation.seoDescription: Browse 255 domain-neutral customer lifecycle journeys as state machines: triggers, conditions, waits, exits and handoffs, with the rules behind each.
recommendation.h1Rationale: The H1 is the library's own name, not a keyword-stuffed repeat of the title tag. The count and the 'lifecycle examples' intent already live in the title; repeating them in the H1 would read as SEO boilerplate to a human landing on the page.

currentState.note: Resolved: /lab/ab-testing/library ([slug]) is now live, mirroring /lab/journeys/[slug]. canonicalPath updated across ab-test-seo-metadata.json accordingly.

openRoutingDecision.question: Should the 211 scenario pages live under the plugin product page (/lab/ab-testing/{slug}), or should the browsable library get its own root the way /lab/journeys did, with the product page linking across to it?
openRoutingDecision.whyItMatters: The journey library resolved this by giving the library its own route (/lab/journeys) separate from any product page. The A/B library has not made that call yet. Nesting a 211-page programmatic library under a single-product marketing page mixes two different intent profiles on one path prefix.
openRoutingDecision.impactIfChanged: Only the canonicalPath field of all 211 records changes — seoTitle, seoDescription, intents and sourceBasis are all route-independent and would survive the move untouched. Regenerating is a one-line prefix swap in the metadata builder, not an authoring round.
openRoutingDecision.status: RESOLVED — /lab/ab-testing stays the plugin landing page; /lab/ab-testing/library is the 211-test browsable index; /lab/ab-testing/library/[slug] is the detail route. Shipped.

recommendation.seoDescription: Browse 211 A/B test ideas across product, checkout, pricing and signup pages: the variable under test, the primary KPI, and the guardrails for each.
recommendation.h1Rationale: Kept distinct from the existing product-page H1 ('An A/B test engine that won't let you skip the guardrail.'), which sells the plugin. If the library gets its own route, these are two different pages with two different jobs; if it does not, the product page needs a library section with this H2 instead.

notAppliedNote: Neither recommendation has been written into src/lib/content.ts. The existing abTesting.metaTitle/metaDesc still describe the plugin product, which is correct for what that page currently is.
